summary.text: Tina Courpas is a Connecticut state representative who lives in Greenwich (Glenville), where she has lived for almost 20 years.

paragraphs.text: She worked for over 20 years in investment banking and corporate law, starting at Goldman, Sachs & Co. and most recently at Silver Point Capital.
She was Executive Director of The Hellenic Initiative and of the Permanent Commission on the Status of Women in Connecticut.
She holds an A.B. from Princeton University and a J.D. from Columbia Law School.
